root/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Rune Prison</titleLeft><titleRight>Level @Level@ [@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Roots the enemy for @Effect1Amount@ second(s), dealing @Effect2Amount@<font color='#99FF99'> (+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> plus @Effect3Amount@% of Ryze's maximum Mana <font color='#44DDFF'>(+@f1@)</font> in magic damage. </mainText>

root/Description.text: Ryze traps target enemy unit in a cage of runes, damaging them and preventing them from moving. Also gains bonus damage based on Ryze's maximum Mana.

blind/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Blinding Dart (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Deals @Effect1Amount@ <font color='#99FF99'>(+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> magic damage and blinds the target for @Effect2Amount@ seconds. </mainText>

blind/Description.text: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

fear/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Terrify (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Strikes a target enemy unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for @Effect2Amount@ seconds.</mainText>

fear/Description.text: Strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.

charm/DynamicTooltip.text:
CharmLevel @Level@ [@Hotkey@]@Cost@ Mana@Cooldown@ sec CooldownBlows a kiss dealing @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharAbilityPower@) magic damage and charms an enemy causing them to walk harmlessly towards Ahri for @Effect2Amount@ second(s).

Enemies hit by Charm take 20% more magic damage from Ahri for 6 seconds. Orb of Deception's true damage is also increased by this effect.

charm/Description.text: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and charms an enemy it encounters, causing them to walk harmlessly towards her. Ahri deals additional damage to recently charmed enemies.

taunt/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Puncturing Taunt (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Rammus taunts the enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault, reducing their Armor by @Effect2Amount@ and forcing them to attack Rammus for @Effect1Amount@ second(s).</mainText>

taunt/Description.text: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against Rammus' hard shell, reducing Armor temporarily.

knockup/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Pulverize (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Alistar smashes the ground, dealing @Effect2Amount@ <font color='#99FF99'>(+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> magic damage and tossing all nearby enemy units into the air, stunning them for 1.5 seconds.</mainText>

knockup/Description.text: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to all nearby enemies and tossing them into the air for 1.5 seconds. On landing, enemies are stunned.

suppression/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Nether Grasp (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress target champion, dealing @Effect1Amount@ <font color='#99FF99'>(+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> Magic Damage over 2.5 seconds.</mainText>

suppression/Description.text: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion and deal damage each second.

silence/DynamicTooltip.text:
Decisive Strike (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]No Cost@Cooldown@ sec CooldownGaren breaks free from all slows affecting him and gains @Effect2Amount@% Movement Speed for @Effect5Amount@ seconds.

His next basic attack within @Effect6Amount@ seconds deals @Effect1Amount@ (+@CharTotalPhysical@) physical damage and silences his target for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.

silence/Description.text: Garen gains a burst of Movement Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him and his next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

tenacity/DynamicTooltip.text:
Courage (@Level@)[@Hotkey@]No Cost@Cooldown@ sec CooldownPassive: Garen gains an additional 20% value from bonus Armor and Magic Resist.

Active: Garen gains a defensive shield for @Effect4Amount@ seconds, reducing incoming damage by @Effect2Amount@% and granting 30% crowd control duration reduction.

tenacity/Description.text: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist. He may also activate this ability to grant himself a shield that reduces incoming damage and crowd control durations for a short time.

push/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Pillar of Ice (@Level@)</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Trundle creates an icy pillar at target location for @Effect1Amount@ seconds, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units by @Effect2Amount@%.</mainText>

push/Description.text: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

annieQ/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Disintegrate</titleLeft><titleRight>Level @Level@ [@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>@Cost@ Mana</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@Cooldown@ sec Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Deals @Effect1Amount@ <font color='#99FF99'>(+@CharAbilityPower@)</font> magic damage. Mana cost and half the cooldown are refunded if Disintegrate kills the target.</mainText>

annieQ/Description.text: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.

exhaust/DynamicTooltip.text: <titleLeft>Exhaust</titleLeft><titleRight>[@Hotkey@]</titleRight><subtitleLeft>No Cost</subtitleLeft><subtitleRight>@f1@ second Cooldown</subtitleRight><mainText>Exhausts target enemy champion, reducing their Movement Speed and Attack Speed by @f3@%, their Armor and Magic Resist by @f4@, and their damage dealt by @f2@% for 2.5 seconds.</mainText>

exhaust/Description.text: Exhausts target enemy champion, reducing their Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 30%, their Armor and Magic Resist by 10, and their damage dealt by 40% for 2.5 seconds.
